What's included

  • 3 Nights Accommodation at Travellers Beach Hotel
  • Full Board Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner)
  • Return SGR Tickets (Economy Class)
  • Transfers from SGR Station to Hotel and back
  • Guided Educational Excursions

What's excluded

  • Personal expenses
  • Optional activities not listed
  • Anything not mentioned above
  • Book now to give your students a memorable coastal learning experience!

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
